mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_agent_tool_output_image_generation ( tool_invocation_id, run_id, request_id, request_source, session_id, tool_call_id, status, error_msg, prompt, mode, summary, size, batch_count, source_image_count, mask_image_count, used_fallback, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{row.toolInvocationId}, #{row.runId}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.requestSource}, #{row.sessionId}, #{row.toolCallId}, #{row.status}, #{row.errorMsg}, #{row.prompt}, #{row.mode}, #{row.summary}, #{row.size}, #{row.batchCount}, #{row.sourceImageCount}, #{row.maskImageCount}, #{row.usedFallback}, NOW(), NOW() FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_tool_output_image_generation WHERE (#{row.toolInvocationId} IS NOT NULL AND tool_invocation_id = #{row.toolInvocationId}) OR (request_id = #{row.requestId} AND tool_call_id = #{row.toolCallId}) )
mapper.select: SELECT id, tool_invocation_id, run_id, request_id, request_source, session_id, tool_call_id, status, error_msg, prompt, mode, summary, size, batch_count, source_image_count, mask_image_count, used_fallback, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_agent_tool_output_image_generation WHERE tool_invocation_id = #{toolInvocationId} LIMIT 1
